subject: SCCs: module election for EU/UK transfers + evidence checklist
messages:
From: Anna Ruiz <anna.ruiz@medequip.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SCC module selection and evidence needed for MedEquip POC

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the demo last week — MedEquip is moving toward a short POC and our legal/privacy team needs to confirm the data transfer approach for EU/UK patient metadata we expect to send. We collect pseudonymized identifiers and some healthcare metadata (HIPAA scope).

Quick asks from our side:
- Confirm which SCC module Redwood expects to execute for controller -> processor transfers (we are the controller).
- Confirm whether Redwood will sign the UK Addendum for transfers involving UK data.
- Provide a checklist of documents/evidence you can share (DPIA, SOC 2 Type II report, subprocessors, data flow diagram).

Can you send a single combined checklist and an expected timeline to get this completed?

Thanks,
Anna Ruiz
Privacy Counsel, MedEquip Inc.
anna.ruiz@medequip.com
+44 20 7123 4567

Attachments: none
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Anna Ruiz <anna.ruiz@medequip.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SCC module selection and evidence needed for MedEquip POC

Hi Anna — looping in Lauren (Legal) and Vanessa (Privacy/Compliance) to confirm details and lead the evidence collection. Short answers up front:

- Module: For controller -> processor transfers Redwood expects Module 2 (Controller to Processor) of the EU SCCs.
- UK: We will execute the UK Addendum where UK personal data are involved; that will be attached to the executed SCCs.

I've attached an evidence checklist (redwood-sccs-evidence-checklist.pdf) that outlines the standard items we can provide and those we require from the controller. High level:
- We can share: SOC 2 Type II report (redacted/under NDA), subprocessors list, security architecture diagram, data flow diagram, and our standard DPIA template.
- We need from MedEquip: confirmation of categories of data, lawful basis, any special category processing details, and a completed DPIA or controller DPIA inputs.

Next steps proposal:
1) MedEquip completes the short DPIA inputs (we can provide the template) — target 5 business days.
2) REDWOOD provides redacted SOC 2 and subprocessors list — 3 business days after NDA/signed DPA.
3) Draft SCCs with UK Addendum routed via DocuSign — we can aim for signature within 10 business days once both parties have shared required inputs.

Lauren / Vanessa / Karthik — can you confirm if any additional evidence is needed for HIPAA-relevant scope (Anna mentioned healthcare metadata)? Also flag any operational controls we should call out.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0134

Attachments: redwood-sccs-evidence-checklist.pdf
From: Oliver Harris <oliver.harris@harrislaw.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Anna Ruiz <anna.ruiz@medequip.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 23 Jul 2025 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SCC module selection and evidence needed for MedEquip POC

Thanks — quick note from counsel. MedEquip is a controller sending pseudonymized patient metadata to Redwood as a processor. Our preference is to proceed by executing the EU SCCs Module 2 (Controller -> Processor) plus the UK Addendum for any UK-resident data. A few items we want included or clarified in the DPA/SCCs:

- Confirm that Redwood will accept the role of processor and not reclassify as a joint controller for the POC scope.
- Subprocessor onboarding: require 15 business days notice for new subprocessors and an objection window.
- Data residency routing: are there routing policies to keep EU data in EU regions by default? If not, we need a clear fallback explanation.
- DPIA: we'll provide a controller DPIA summary. Please provide your DPIA template and any notes on residual risk.

Evidence requested up front (to keep the timeline tight):
- Redacted SOC 2 Type II report (past 12 months)
- Data flow diagram covering ingestion -> processing -> storage (we attached our current version as context)
- Current subprocessors CSV with roles

If those items are available this week we can accelerate the DPA review.

Regards,
Oliver Harris
Senior Associate, Harris & Co. (external counsel to MedEquip)
oliver.harris@harrislaw.com

Attachment: medequip-dataflow-v2.png
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Anna Ruiz <anna.ruiz@medequip.com>, Oliver Harris <oliver.harris@harrislaw.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 25 Jul 2025 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SCC module selection and evidence needed for MedEquip POC

Hi Anna / Oliver — thanks for the confirmation and the dataflow graphic, that's very helpful. Confirming the plan and providing an explicit evidence checklist and timeline below. We'll treat the POC scope as processor activity only and we accept Module 2 + UK Addendum for UK transfers.

Evidence Redwood will provide (we can deliver these under NDA):
- Redacted SOC 2 Type II (most recent) — expected delivery: 3 business days after NDA in place.
- Subprocessors list (CSV) — available now; attached sample (subprocessors-202507.csv).
- High-level DPIA template and our internal notes on residual risk — 2 business days.
- Technical data flow / architecture diagram (redwood internal) — 4 business days.

Items we need from MedEquip to finalize DPA/SCCs:
- Completed controller DPIA inputs (short form) — target: 5 business days from today.
- Confirmation of categories of personal data and any special categories (if applicable).
- Point of contact for procurement to receive DocuSign.

Operational notes / concessions proposed:
- Subprocessor notice: Redwood will provide notice and a 10 business day objection window for this POC (we can extend on a case-by-case basis).
- Data residency: by default EU customer workloads are routed to EU region; for the POC we'll explicitly pin the ingest to eu-west-1 where possible and document fallback behavior.

We will prepare a draft DPA with Module 2 + UK Addendum and route it via DocuSign. Expected signature target: 10 business days after MedEquip returns the DPIA inputs and proc contact is confirmed. DocuSign link will be provided in the next email.

Action items:
- Anna: share procurement contact and confirm DPIA timeline.
- Oliver: advise if 10 business days objection window on subprocessors is acceptable or if you need 15.
- Lauren / Vanessa / Karthik: please review the operational notes above and flag anything we should include in the draft DPA around HIPAA scope.

Thanks,
Soojin
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com

Attachments: subprocessors-202507.csv, redwood-sccs-evidence-checklist.pdf
